toolchains.codegen_backend: Cranelift for dev builds (cargo 1.100.0-nightly), LLVM for the proof profile

conditions: Hosted GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 runner, 4 vCPU and 16 GiB, x64. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, no sccache. Five samples per profile and phase, profiles interleaved run by run, medians selected.

workloads.description: Cold build of the shipped workspace with no default features.
workloads.notes: Run cold, native-only profile, from .github/workflows/profile-measurements.yml build-budget in run 42650004173. Profiles alternate run by run within one runner; each cold sample starts from an empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR and each measured a 485671-byte target by `du -sb` apparent size, which is not a content hash and has no earlier figure to compare against. The first sample includes a cold filesystem and is retained rather than discarded; the median is the third of the five sorted samples, 0.25 s, and the first sample alone rose against the 2026-11-08 measurement.

workloads.description: Cold build of the shipped workspace with default (Polars) features.
workloads.notes: Run cold, polars-enabled profile, from .github/workflows/profile-measurements.yml build-budget in run 42650004173. Profiles alternate run by run within one runner; each cold sample starts from an empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR and each measured a 826044445-byte target by `du -sb` apparent size, consistent across the five runs but not a content hash and with no earlier figure to compare against.

Run cold, proof profile, from .github/workflows/profile-measurements.yml build-budget in run 42650004173. Profiles alternate run by run within one runner; each cold sample starts from an empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR.

workloads.description: Incremental rebuild with no default features after touching the crate root.
workloads.notes: Run incremental, native-only profile, from .github/workflows/profile-measurements.yml build-budget in run 42650004173. Each incremental sample follows one discarded warm-up build.
